title.zh: 美国制裁俄罗斯影子银行网络A7 Network并拟限制其支付
title.en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments

current_state.zh: 美国财政部已制裁俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其A7A5代币，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理/前线公司的转移，包括可转换虚拟货币，并估算超180个实体通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元。
current_state.en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents/front companies, including convertible virtual currency, and estimated more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5.

updates.title_zh: 美国制裁 A7 Network，并提议禁止向其子代理付款
updates.title_en: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments
updates.what_changed_zh:
美国对与俄罗斯相关的支付网络 A7 Network 实施制裁，美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）同时提出一项规则草案，拟禁止涉及该网络“子代理”（Sub-Agents）的资金汇付。FinCEN 表示，2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，A7 的子代理处理了超过 170 亿美元的美元计价交易。

该规则草案把美国的限制范围从 A7 本身扩大到在 A7 相关发票和付款指令中充当签约方或付款方的境外子代理；FinCEN 称这一层被用来从非俄罗斯银行账户转移资金。该付款禁令目前仍属提案，尚未生效。

根据 FinCEN 的规则制定提案通知，A7 Network 会指派境外子代理作为发票、销售协议和付款指令上的签约方或付款方，从而使款项能够通过代理行和 SWIFT 渠道从非俄罗斯银行账户支付。该措施与美国财政部代号“Operation Economic Outcast”的行动一并公布。
updates.what_changed_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.

该规则草案把美国的限制范围从 A7 本身扩大到在 A7 相关发票和付款指令中充当签约方或付款方的境外子代理；FinCEN 称这一层被用来从非俄罗斯银行账户转移资金。该付款禁令目前仍属提案，尚未生效。

updates.current_state_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.background_zh: 据描述，A7 为俄罗斯个人和实体（包括受制裁对象）提供跨境资金转移，依托俄罗斯和吉尔吉斯斯坦的银行基础设施、位于吉尔吉斯斯坦的加密交易所 Grinex（受制裁的 Garantex 的继任者）以及第三国的壳公司网络。A7 发行与卢布挂钩的稳定币 A7A5。信息韧性中心（Centre for Information Resilience）2025 年 10 月的报告将 A7 利用境外壳公司和本票的做法描述为一种贸易洗钱，并称 A7 宣称其“付款公司”网络中有 30 多家壳公司。
updates.background_en: A7 is described as enabling cross-border money transfers to Russian individuals and entities, including those under sanctions, using bank infrastructure in Russia and Kyrgyzstan, the Kyrgyzstan-based crypto exchange Grinex (a successor to the sanctioned Garantex), and a network of shell companies in third countries. It issues the ruble-pegged stablecoin A7A5. An October 2025 report by the Centre for Information Resilience described A7's use of foreign shell companies and promissory notes as a form of trade-based money laundering, and said A7 claims over 30 shell companies in its network of "payer companies."
updates.market_impact_zh: 该禁令草案针对的是从非俄罗斯银行账户划出资金的子代理环节，因此直接敞口在于代理行交易对手、加密交易所，以及与 A7A5 或 Grinex 相关的卢布锚定稳定币结算通道，传导渠道是合规与去风险压力，而非协议规则的变化。此前有报道称 A7 相关资金流经全球银行，这也意味着处理相关交易对手的机构面临更高的筛查风险。
updates.market_impact_en: The proposed prohibition targets the sub-agent layer that routes payments out of non-Russian bank accounts, so the direct exposure sits with correspondent-banking counterparties, crypto exchanges and ruble-pegged stablecoin settlement rails linked to A7A5 or Grinex, transmitted through compliance and de-risking pressure rather than any change to protocol rules. A7-linked flows reported through global banks also point to heightened screening risk for institutions handling related counterparties.

updates.what_changed_zh: 美国财政部制裁与俄罗斯有关联的影子银行网络A7 Network及其以卢布为支撑的A7A5代币，称其涉及超过170亿美元的转账和规避制裁行为，同时FinCEN提议限制通过其代理网络进行的转账，并发布了风险提示。
updates.what_changed_en: The US Treasury sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its ruble-backed A7A5 token, citing over $17 billion in transfers and sanctions evasion, while FinCEN proposed restricting transfers through its correspondent network and issued a risk advisory.

updates.title_zh: 美国盯上涉资170亿美元、以USDT作为逃生通道的俄罗斯关联加密支付网络
updates.title_en: US targets $17 billion Russia-linked crypto payment network using USDT as an escape route
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国财政部将A7网络指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，将制裁范围从个别公司扩大到整个支付网络；FinCEN同时提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及已识别A7子代理的资金转移。
updates.what_changed_en: The US Treasury designated A7 Network as a significant transnational criminal organization, expanding blocking sanctions from individual companies to the broader payment network, while FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transmitting funds involving identified A7 sub-agents.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国财政部已对俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其卢布支持的A7A5代币实施制裁，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理的转移，同时发布风险指引。网络据称通过A7A5、USDT和中介转移超过170亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its ruble-backed A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents and issued a risk advisory. The network allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US Treasury sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 payment network and FinCEN proposed new restrictions barring covered financial institutions from handling transfers involving its sub-agents, targeting a system that allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US Treasury sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 payment network and FinCEN proposed new restrictions barring covered financial institutions from handling transfers involving its sub-agents, targeting a system that allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.

updates.title_zh: 美国将俄罗斯的 A7 Network 列为跨国犯罪组织
updates.title_en: US Designates Russia's A7 Network as Transnational Criminal Organization
updates.what_changed_zh: Decrypt报道补充了FinCEN的详细估算：超过180个实体在2025年2月至2026年6月间通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元；拟议规则覆盖可转换虚拟货币，并依据《打击俄罗斯洗钱法》第9714条第六项特别措施，约束约34.8万家机构。
updates.what_changed_en: Decrypt added FinCEN detail estimating that more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5 between February 2025 and June 2026; the proposed rule covers convertible virtual currency and uses the sixth special measure under Section 9714 of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act, binding roughly 348,000 institutions.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国财政部已制裁俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其A7A5代币，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理/前线公司的转移，包括可转换虚拟货币，并估算超180个实体通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents/front companies, including convertible virtual currency, and estimated more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
